_note: Chapter 23 词汇卡内容。ipa = 音标; ex = 例句数组, 顺序与词表中该词出现的行序一致(多词性词给多个例句, 每个例句对应词性行); note = 用法提示/搭配。

ex.en: Her acceptance of the new job came with a long list of conditions.
ex.cn: 她接受这份新工作，却附带了一长串条件。
ex.note: win acceptance 赢得认可；acceptance of 对…的接受

ex.en: The medicine did not act quickly enough to save the patient.
ex.cn: 这药没能及时起效，没能救回病人。
ex.note: act on 作用于；act as 充当

ex.en: Handing in the report was a brave act.
ex.cn: 交出那份报告是个勇敢的举动。
ex.note: an act of kindness 善举

ex.en: They put up an advertisement for the new exhibition on the wall.
ex.cn: 他们在墙上为新展览贴了一则广告。
ex.note: an advertisement for … …的广告

ex.en: We took a taxi from the airport to the city centre.
ex.cn: 我们从机场打车到市中心。
ex.note: at the airport 在机场；airport shuttle 机场接驳车

ex.en: Someone called an ambulance as soon as the old man collapsed.
ex.cn: 老人一倒下，就有人叫了救护车。
ex.note: call an ambulance 叫救护车；by ambulance 乘救护车

ex.en: She felt a quiet anxiety about the exam results.
ex.cn: 她对考试成绩有一种隐隐的焦虑。
ex.note: anxiety about 对…的焦虑；ease anxiety 缓解焦虑

ex.en: Casual clothes are not appropriate for a job interview.
ex.cn: 休闲装不适合求职面试。
ex.note: be appropriate for 适合；形容词读 /əˈprəʊpriət/

ex.en: The city council has appropriated more funds for public libraries.
ex.cn: 市议会已为公共图书馆拨出更多经费。
ex.note: appropriate funds 拨款；动词读 /əˈprəʊpreɪt/

ex.en: The letter was reduced to ash in the fire.
ex.cn: 那封信在火里化成了灰烬。
ex.note: burn to ash 烧成灰烬；ashes of … 的灰烬

ex.en: He attempted to fix the machine by himself.
ex.cn: 他试着独自修好那台机器。
ex.note: attempt to do 试图做；make an attempt 尝试

ex.en: There was an awkward silence after her question.
ex.cn: 她问完话之后，出现了一阵尴尬的沉默。
ex.note: an awkward silence 尴尬的沉默；awkward at 不善交际

ex.en: The old barn now stores the village's old farming tools.
ex.cn: 那座旧谷仓如今存放着村里的老农具。
ex.note: a hay barn 干草仓；barnyard 谷仓庭院

ex.en: She wants to become a doctor after years of medical school.
ex.cn: 经过多年的医学院学习，她想成为一名医生。
ex.note: become of 出于；become famous 成名

ex.en: If you want the best results, check the label twice.
ex.cn: 想要最好的效果，就把标签检查两遍。
ex.note: the best of … …中的最好部分；do one's best 尽力

ex.en: The museum has blended modern design with the old building.
ex.cn: 博物馆把现代设计融进了这座老建筑。
ex.note: blend A with B 把 A 与 B 混合；a blend of 混合物

ex.en: May I borrow your pen for a moment?
ex.cn: 我能借用一下你的笔吗？
ex.note: borrow sth. from sb. 向某人借某物；borrow money 借钱

ex.en: He gave a brief introduction before the lecture began.
ex.cn: 讲座开始前，他做了一个简短的介绍。
ex.note: a brief talk 简短的谈话；in brief 简言之

ex.en: The brief of the project was only one page long.
ex.cn: 这个项目的任务书只有一页纸长。
ex.note: the brief of … …的任务书

ex.en: She briefed the team on the new plan before the meeting.
ex.cn: 会前她把新计划向团队做了简要说明。
ex.note: brief sb. on sth. 向某人简要介绍某事

ex.en: The exam was hard, but he finished it on time.
ex.cn: 考试很难，但他还是按时做完了。
ex.note: not … but … 不是…而是…

ex.en: Everyone but Tom knew the answer.
ex.cn: 除了汤姆，所有人都知道答案。
ex.note: but for 除…之外（虚拟语气）

ex.en: Three students were named as candidates for the departmental prize.
ex.cn: 有三名学生被提名为系里奖项的候选人。
ex.note: a candidate for … …的候选人；run as a candidate 参选

ex.en: The castle has stood on the hill for six hundred years.
ex.cn: 这座城堡在山上矗立了六百年。
ex.note: a castle in the air 空中楼阁

ex.en: The chairman opened the meeting and welcomed everyone.
ex.cn: 主席宣布开会，并欢迎了所有人。
ex.note: chairman of a committee 委员会主席

ex.en: They played a game of chess in the hall after dinner.
ex.cn: 晚饭后他们在厅里下了一盘国际象棋。
ex.note: play chess 下国际象棋；a chess set 一副国际象棋

ex.en: The old man made a civil objection to the guide's comment.
ex.cn: 老人客气地对讲解员的话提出了异议。
ex.note: civil rights 公民权利；civil society 公民社会

ex.en: Dark clouds gathered over the hills before the storm.
ex.cn: 暴风雨前，乌云在山头上聚集。
ex.note: a cloud of 一团；cloudy 阴天的

ex.en: The results will come at the end of next week.
ex.cn: 结果要在下周末才出来。
ex.note: come true 实现；come across 偶然遇到

ex.en: The prize was competitive, and only one student could win.
ex.cn: 这个奖项竞争激烈，只能有一位学生获奖。
ex.note: highly competitive 竞争激烈的

ex.en: Please condense your report into no more than two pages.
ex.cn: 请把你的报告压缩到不超过两页。
ex.note: condense sth. into sth. 把…压缩成…

ex.en: It was considerate of you to warn me about the change.
ex.cn: 你提前告知我变动这件事，真是体贴。
ex.note: be considerate of sb. 对某人体贴；considerate of others 体贴他人

ex.en: The museum controls the temperature in every gallery.
ex.cn: 博物馆控制着每个展厅的温度。
ex.note: have control over 对…有控制力；under control 处于控制之中

ex.en: The cost of restoring the roof was far beyond our budget.
ex.cn: 修缮屋顶的费用远远超出了我们的预算。
ex.note: the cost of … …的费用；at the cost of 以…为代价

ex.en: His carelessness cost the team three days of work.
ex.cn: 他的粗心让团队白白损失了三天工期。
ex.note: cost sb. sth. 使某人付出某代价

ex.en: He felt crazy for staying up until midnight over a single page.
ex.cn: 为了单独一页稿子熬到半夜，他觉得简直疯了。
ex.note: go crazy 疯掉；crazy about 对…着迷

ex.en: He learned to cultivate a habit of asking good questions.
ex.cn: 他学会了培养提出好问题的习惯。
ex.note: cultivate a habit 培养习惯；cultivate the soil 耕地

ex.en: The reading room was so dark that he had to turn on the lamp.
ex.cn: 阅览室太暗，他不得不打开台灯。
ex.note: dark blue 深蓝色；in the dark 在黑暗中

ex.en: Most of the work was done in the dark of night.
ex.cn: 大部分工作是在夜色中完成的。
ex.note: in the dark 在黑暗中；the dark 黑暗

ex.en: The curator declared the old label wrong the next morning.
ex.cn: 第二天早上，馆长宣布原来的标签是错的。
ex.note: declare that … 宣布…；declare war 宣战

ex.en: The density of the metal suggested that it was solid bronze.
ex.cn: 这种金属的密度表明它是实心青铜。
ex.note: population density 人口密度

ex.en: The first chapter gives the details of the excavation.
ex.cn: 第一章给出了这次发掘的细节。
ex.note: in detail 详细地；go into details 详述

ex.en: She detailed the results of the experiment in three short paragraphs.
ex.cn: 她用三个简短的段落详述了实验结果。
ex.note: detail the story 详述故事

ex.en: It took him a week to digest so much new information.
ex.cn: 他花了一周时间才消化这么多新信息。
ex.note: digest food 消化食物；digest the news 消化消息

ex.en: The newspaper publishes a digest of the week's news every Sunday.
ex.cn: 这家报纸每周日出一份一周新闻摘要。
ex.note: a digest of … …的摘要

ex.en: The class discussion lasted longer than anyone had expected.
ex.cn: 课堂讨论持续的时间比任何人预想的都长。
ex.note: have a discussion about 讨论；under discussion 在讨论中

ex.en: She felt dizzy and had to sit down for a moment.
ex.cn: 她觉得头晕，不得不坐下来歇一会儿。
ex.note: feel dizzy 感到头晕；a dizzy spell 一阵眩晕

ex.en: A porter dragged a heavy crate across the floor.
ex.cn: 一名搬运工把沉重的板箱拖过地板。
ex.note: drag sth. across 拖过；drag one's feet 拖延

ex.en: During the quiet morning, only a few visitors came in.
ex.cn: 在那个安静的上午，只有寥寥几位游客进来。
ex.note: during the day 在白天

ex.en: The findings will appear in the next edition of the catalogue.
ex.cn: 这些发现将出现在下一版目录里。
ex.note: a new edition 新版；the first edition 初版

ex.en: The elevator was out of order, so we took the stairs.
ex.cn: 电梯坏了，我们只好走楼梯。
ex.note: ride the elevator 乘电梯

ex.en: The storage room seemed to contain endless piles of junk.
ex.cn: 库房仿佛堆着无穷无尽的杂物。
ex.note: endless debates 无休止的争论

ex.en: The exhibition argues for equality between everyday objects.
ex.cn: 这场展览主张日常器物之间的平等。
ex.note: equality of 平等；gender equality 性别平等

ex.en: It was evident that she had not eaten since morning.
ex.cn: 显然她从早上起就没吃过东西。
ex.note: it is evident that … 显然……

ex.en: Few people know about the long existence of the old bridge.
ex.cn: 很少有人知道这座老桥存在了多久。
ex.note: existence of … 的存在；a mere existence 仅有的生存

ex.en: She has a sharp eye for detail in old paintings.
ex.cn: 她对古画中的细节眼光很敏锐。
ex.note: keep an eye on 留意；an eye for 对…有眼光

ex.en: The night event was held as a farewell to the exhibition.
ex.cn: 那场夜间活动是为展览举行的告别仪式。
ex.note: bid farewell to 告别；a farewell party 告别派对

ex.en: The teacher gave him honest feedback on his first draft.
ex.cn: 老师就他的初稿给了中肯的反馈。
ex.note: give feedback on 对…给出反馈；feedback from 来自…的反馈

ex.en: The finding changed the way people understood the object.
ex.cn: 这一发现改变了人们对这件器物的理解。
ex.note: research findings 研究成果；a key finding 关键发现

ex.en: The bowl was painted with a single white flower.
ex.cn: 那只碗上画着一朵白花。
ex.note: flower shop 花店；in full bloom 盛开

ex.en: A farmer's fork was displayed next to a king's cup.
ex.cn: 一把农夫的叉子和国王的杯子并排陈列着。
ex.note: fork and knife 刀叉；a fork in the road 分岔路口

ex.en: The report is due on Friday, so I still have two days.
ex.cn: 报告周五截止，我还剩两天。
ex.note: on Friday 在周五；Friday evening 周五晚上

ex.en: He gained useful experience from the museum project.
ex.cn: 他从博物馆的项目里获得了有益的经验。
ex.note: gain confidence 获得信心；gain weight 增重

ex.en: The shop saw a steady gain in sales during the summer.
ex.cn: 这家店夏天的销售额稳定增长。
ex.note: a gain in 在…方面的增长；a gain in profit 利润增长

ex.en: He measured the geometry of the drawing with a ruler.
ex.cn: 他用尺子量了图样的几何尺寸。
ex.note: the geometry of … …的几何结构

ex.en: For goodness' sake, give the poor old man some air.
ex.cn: 看在老天爷的份上，让那位可怜的老人透透气吧。
ex.note: for goodness' sake 看在老天爷的份上；Thank goodness 谢天谢地

ex.en: He wore a gray coat on that cold morning.
ex.cn: 那个寒冷的早晨，他穿着一件灰色外套。
ex.note: gray hair 灰白头发；ash-gray 灰白的

ex.en: The building used to be a gym before it became a museum.
ex.cn: 这座建筑从前是体育馆，后来才改成博物馆。
ex.note: go to the gym 去健身房；gym shoes 运动鞋

ex.en: In his haste to finish the report, he repeated himself twice.
ex.cn: 他急于写完报告，话说得重复了两遍。
ex.note: in haste 匆忙地；haste makes waste 欲速则不达

ex.en: Could you help me move this heavy table?
ex.cn: 你能帮我挪一下这张重桌子吗？
ex.note: help sb. with sth. 在某事上帮助某人；help oneself to 随便用

ex.en: The stone hit the floor with a loud crack.
ex.cn: 石头砸在地上，发出一声脆响。
ex.note: hit the target 命中目标；hit the road 动身

ex.en: The show was an immediate hit with college students.
ex.cn: 这场演出立刻在大学生中引起轰动。
ex.note: a hit song 热门歌曲；a hit movie 热门电影

ex.en: The ambulance arrived within the hour.
ex.cn: 救护车不到一小时就到了。
ex.note: within the hour 一小时内；hour by hour 一小时一小时地

ex.en: A single word can change the identity of an object.
ex.cn: 一个词就能改变一件东西的身份。
ex.note: the identity of … …的身份；identity card 身份证

ex.en: He did not wish to impose his opinion on the guide.
ex.cn: 他不愿把自己的意见强加给讲解员。
ex.note: impose sth. on sb. 把…强加给某人；impose taxes on 征收税

ex.en: Some disagreement was inevitable when the report was discussed.
ex.cn: 报告被讨论时，出现分歧在所难免。
ex.note: it is inevitable that … 不可避免的是…

ex.en: The guide did not insist when the old man disagreed.
ex.cn: 老人不同意时，讲解员没有再坚持。
ex.note: insist on doing 坚持做；insist that … 坚持认为…

ex.en: The course is for intermediate students who already know the basics.
ex.cn: 这门课是给已经掌握基础的中级学生上的。
ex.note: an intermediate level 中级水平；the intermediate period 中期

ex.en: The old building seemed to pull itself out of the past.
ex.cn: 那座老楼像是要从往昔里挣脱出来。
ex.note: by itself 独自；of itself 自动地

ex.en: The storage room was full of junk that nobody had sorted.
ex.cn: 库房里堆着没人整理过的杂物。
ex.note: a pile of junk 一堆垃圾；junk food 垃圾食品

ex.en: We borrowed an X-ray machine from the physics lab.
ex.cn: 我们从物理实验室借来了一台X光机。
ex.note: a language lab 语言实验室；laboratory assistant 实验室助理

ex.en: They walked across the lawn to the old museum building.
ex.cn: 他们穿过草坪，走向那座老博物馆。
ex.note: mow the lawn 修剪草坪；on the lawn 在草坪上

ex.en: The length of the rope on display was longer than his arm.
ex.cn: 陈列着的那段绳子的长度比他的胳膊还长。
ex.note: the length of … …的长度；a length of time 一段时间

ex.en: A bronze lion stood beside the gate of the museum.
ex.cn: 博物馆门口立着一头青铜狮子。
ex.note: the lion's share 最大的份额；sea lion 海狮

ex.en: A loose label fell from the crate as it was moved.
ex.cn: 板箱挪动时，一张松掉的标签掉了下来。
ex.note: a loose fit 宽松；tie up loose ends 收拾残局

ex.en: The view from the top of the hill was magnificent.
ex.cn: 从山顶望出去的景色壮丽非凡。
ex.note: magnificent in … 在某方面出色

ex.en: A married couple near the door held hands while they waited.
ex.cn: 门边一对夫妻等待时紧紧握着手。
ex.note: be married to sb. 与某人结婚；a married couple 一对夫妻

ex.en: He was given a small medal for his research.
ex.cn: 他因这项研究得到了一枚小奖牌。
ex.note: win a gold medal 赢得金牌；a medal for 因…而得的奖章

ex.en: It might rain before the seminar begins.
ex.cn: 研讨课开始之前可能会下雨。
ex.note: might have done 可能做过（对过去的推测）

ex.en: Few people understand the might of the storm that struck the coast.
ex.cn: 很少有人明白那场袭击海岸的风暴有多大的威力。
ex.note: the might of … …的力量；with all one's might 竭尽全力

ex.en: Mobile payment has changed the way small shops do business.
ex.cn: 移动支付改变了小店的经营方式。
ex.note: mobile phone 手机；mobile payment 移动支付

ex.en: His mobile buzzed on the table, but he ignored it.
ex.cn: 他的手机在桌上嗡嗡震动，他却没理会。
ex.note: on one's mobile 用手机；mobile phone 手机

ex.en: He had no motive except curiosity about that old object.
ex.cn: 除了对那件旧物的好奇，他别无动机。
ex.note: the motive for … …的动机；without motive 无所图

ex.en: The visitor's name was on a card at the front desk.
ex.cn: 那位访客的名字写在前台的一张卡片上。
ex.note: in the name of 以…的名义；name sb. after sb. 以…给…命名

ex.en: The catalogue names the object as a bronze needle.
ex.cn: 目录把这件东西列为青铜针。
ex.note: name sb. sth. 给某人取名某物；be named after 以…命名

ex.en: It took a lot of nerve to speak in front of the whole class.
ex.cn: 在全班面前讲话需要很大的勇气。
ex.note: lose one's nerve 失去勇气；the nerve to do 做某事的勇气

ex.en: The shop closes at noon and reopens at two.
ex.cn: 商店中午关门，两点再开。
ex.note: at noon 在正午；before noon 午前

ex.en: He made a polite objection to the guide's description.
ex.cn: 他对讲解员的描述提出了客气的异议。
ex.note: raise an objection to 对…提出异议；objection to 对…的反对

ex.en: He walked past several oil paintings without stopping.
ex.cn: 他走过几幅油画，没有停留。
ex.note: oil painting 油画；crude oil 原油

ex.en: Oil the hinges once a year so they do not rust.
ex.cn: 每年给合页上一次油，免得生锈。
ex.note: oil the hinges 给铰链上油；oil the machine 给机器上油

ex.en: A small orchestra played in the courtyard that evening.
ex.cn: 那天晚上，一支小型管弦乐队在庭院里演奏。
ex.note: a symphony orchestra 交响乐团；orchestra conductor 乐队指挥

ex.en: The bridge over the river was built a century ago.
ex.cn: 河上的那座桥建于一百年前。
ex.note: over and over 反复；over there 在那边

ex.en: An old iron pan hung on the wall of the kitchen.
ex.cn: 一口旧铁锅挂在厨房的墙上。
ex.note: frying pan 平底锅；pan and cover 一整套器皿

ex.en: There was a thick layer of paste on the label.
ex.cn: 标签上糊着一层厚厚的浆糊。
ex.note: a tube of paste 一管浆糊；toothpaste 牙膏

ex.en: Paste the photograph onto the last page of the report.
ex.cn: 把照片贴到报告的最后一页上。
ex.note: paste sth. onto sth. 把…贴到…上

ex.en: She perceived a change in the tone of his voice.
ex.cn: 她察觉出他语气里的变化。
ex.note: perceive sth. as 把…看作；perceive that … 察觉到…

ex.en: He wrote the phrase in his notebook and underlined it.
ex.cn: 他把这个短语写在笔记本上，还画了线。
ex.note: a key phrase 关键词组；in simple phrases 用简单的话

ex.en: A planet shone beside the moon on that clear night.
ex.cn: 那个晴朗的夜里，一颗行星在月亮旁边闪耀。
ex.note: the planet 地球；a planet of 星球般的

ex.en: He was polite but firm in his disagreement.
ex.cn: 他提出异议时态度客气而坚定。
ex.note: be polite to sb. 对某人有礼貌；a polite refusal 客气的拒绝

ex.en: The museum shop sells postcards of the night event.
ex.cn: 博物馆商店出售那场夜间活动的明信片。
ex.note: a postcard from … 来自…的明信片

ex.en: He checked every preposition before handing in the essay.
ex.cn: 交作文之前他把每个介词都检查了一遍。
ex.note: after a preposition 在介词之后；a preposition phrase 介词短语

ex.en: It is a privilege to study objects that have survived so long.
ex.cn: 能研究留存至今的器物是一种荣幸。
ex.note: the privilege of … …的荣幸；privileged 特权的

ex.en: A large proportion of the students chose the morning class.
ex.cn: 很大一部分学生选了上午的课。
ex.note: a large proportion of 大部分的；the proportion of … …的比例

ex.en: He made a small purchase before leaving the shop.
ex.cn: 离开商店前，他小小地买了一样东西。
ex.note: make a purchase 购物；purchase sth. from sb. 从某人处购买

ex.en: She wiped the shelf with an old rag.
ex.cn: 她用一块旧抹布擦了擦架子。
ex.note: a piece of rag 一块破布；rag and bone 破烂

ex.en: He realized that reality was more complicated than the story.
ex.cn: 他意识到现实比故事复杂。
ex.note: in reality 事实上；the reality of … 的现实

ex.en: She reflected on her years in the old building.
ex.cn: 她回顾了自己在那座老楼里的岁月。
ex.note: reflect on 深思；reflect that … 反映…

ex.en: The news that the doctor was safe relieved her anxiety.
ex.cn: 医生平安的消息让她松了一口气。
ex.note: relieve sb. of sth. 缓解某人的……；relieve pain 减轻痛苦

ex.en: The main requirement of the job is to work at night.
ex.cn: 这份工作的主要要求是夜间工作。
ex.note: meet the requirements 满足要求；a basic requirement 基本要求

ex.en: The chairman will retire at the end of the year.
ex.cn: 主席将在年底退休。
ex.note: retire from 退休自；retire to bed 就寝

ex.en: No one has ever tried to rob the collection.
ex.cn: 从来没有人试图抢劫这批藏品。
ex.note: rob sb. of sth. 抢走某人的某物；rob a bank 抢劫银行

ex.en: The museum runs special tours every Saturday morning.
ex.cn: 博物馆每周六上午开设特别的导览。
ex.note: run a shop 经营商店；run along 继续

ex.en: They had a long run of rainy weather in June.
ex.cn: 六月里他们遇上了连续多日的雨天。
ex.note: a run of 一连串；in the long run 从长远看

ex.en: He made sausage sandwiches while the others worked.
ex.cn: 其他人干活的时候，他在做香肠三明治。
ex.note: sausage rolls 香肠卷；grilled sausage 烤香肠

ex.en: She screamed when she saw the mouse under the bed.
ex.cn: 她看见床底下的老鼠时尖叫了一声。
ex.note: scream at 对…尖叫；a scream 一声尖叫

ex.en: At the seminar the professor praised his report in public.
ex.cn: 在研讨课上，教授公开表扬了他的报告。
ex.note: attend a seminar 参加研讨会；a graduate seminar 研究生研讨课

ex.en: Shall we meet in front of the library at eight?
ex.cn: 我们八点在图书馆前见好吗？
ex.note: shall 用于建议和提议；Shall we …? 我们…好吗？

ex.en: He looked over his shoulder to check the door.
ex.cn: 他回头看了一眼门口。
ex.note: over one's shoulder 回头；shoulder to shoulder 肩并肩

ex.en: She shouldered the responsibility without complaining.
ex.cn: 她一声不吭地担起了这份责任。
ex.note: shoulder the responsibility 承担责任

ex.en: The whole audience was singing the chorus at the end of the song.
ex.cn: 歌曲结束时全场观众一起唱起了副歌。
ex.note: sing along 跟唱；sing a song 唱歌

ex.en: The museum has a slim budget but a large collection.
ex.cn: 博物馆预算微薄，藏品却很多。
ex.note: a slim chance 微小的机会；slim and tall 瘦高

ex.en: He slimmed down to a thinner version of the report.
ex.cn: 他把报告精简成了一份更薄的稿子。
ex.note: slim down 精简；slim down the plan 缩减计划

ex.en: The ancient seeds had been found in the dry soil.
ex.cn: 那些古老的种子是在干燥的土壤里被发现的。
ex.note: rich soil 沃土；soil erosion 水土流失

ex.en: He soiled his hands while working in the garden.
ex.cn: 他在园子里干活，弄脏了双手。
ex.note: soil one's hands 弄脏双手；soil the reputation 玷污名声

ex.en: Many birds fly to the southern coast in winter.
ex.cn: 许多鸟儿冬天飞往南方的海岸。
ex.note: the southern coast 南部海岸；Southern Europe 南欧

ex.en: The old house had a strange spiritual quality.
ex.cn: 那座老房子带着一种奇特的灵性。
ex.note: spiritual value 精神价值；spiritual life 精神生活

ex.en: A child stared at the ancient coin for a long time.
ex.cn: 一个孩子盯着那枚古币看了很久。
ex.note: stare at 盯着看；a blank stare 茫然的目光

ex.en: The wall was built of grey stone two centuries ago.
ex.cn: 那面墙是用灰色的石头在两百年前砌成的。
ex.note: a stone stamp 石印；throw stones 扔石头

ex.en: He had a strong feeling that the label was wrong.
ex.cn: 他有一种强烈的感觉：那个标签是错的。
ex.note: strong belief 坚定的信念；strong winds 强风

ex.en: This film is not suitable for children under twelve.
ex.cn: 这部电影不适合十二岁以下的儿童观看。
ex.note: be suitable for 适合；a suitable candidate 合适的人选

ex.en: He refused to surrender his curiosity to any easy answer.
ex.cn: 他不肯把好奇心交给任何一个轻易的答案。
ex.note: surrender to 屈服于；surrender oneself 投降

ex.en: Every object in the hall had a small tag with its name.
ex.cn: 厅里的每件东西都挂着一张写有名字的小标签。
ex.note: a name tag 名牌；a price tag 价格标签

ex.en: The porter tagged each crate before moving it.
ex.cn: 搬运工在挪动每个板箱前都贴上了标签。
ex.note: tag sth. with sth. 给…贴上…；tag along 跟着

ex.en: A television crew filmed the visitors that evening.
ex.cn: 那天晚上，一支电视摄制组拍下了来访的观众。
ex.note: on television 在电视上；a television set 电视机

ex.en: The students left their books in the reading room.
ex.cn: 学生们把书落在了阅览室。
ex.note: their 是 they 的所有格，表示“他们的东西”

ex.en: Her first thought was that the label must be wrong.
ex.cn: 她第一个念头是那个标签一定错了。
ex.note: on second thought 再想一想；thought of 想法

ex.en: She gave him a useful tip about the old catalogue.
ex.cn: 她给了他一个关于那本旧目录的有用提示。
ex.note: a useful tip 有用的建议；the tip of … …的尖端

ex.en: He tipped the waiter and left the table without waiting for the change.
ex.cn: 他给了侍者小费，没等找零就离开了餐桌。
ex.note: tip sb. 给小费；tip the balance 倾斜

ex.en: Tourism to the old town rose sharply after the exhibition.
ex.cn: 展览之后，到古镇观光的人数急剧上升。
ex.note: tourism industry 旅游业；boost tourism 促进旅游业

ex.en: The museum keeps its greatest treasures in a locked room.
ex.cn: 博物馆把最珍贵的藏品锁在一间屋子里。
ex.note: a treasure house 宝库；a treasure trove 聚宝盆

ex.en: He treasured the memory of that quiet morning.
ex.cn: 他珍藏着那个安静清晨的记忆。
ex.note: treasure sb.'s memory 珍视某人的记忆

ex.en: She hummed a cheerful tune while she worked.
ex.cn: 她一边干活一边哼着一支轻快的曲子。
ex.note: in tune 合调；a catchy tune 动听的曲调

ex.en: He tuned the radio to the local station.
ex.cn: 他把收音机调到本地电台。
ex.note: tune the radio 调收音机；tune up 调音

ex.en: The collection will undoubtedly change again in a few years.
ex.cn: 这批藏品几年之后无疑还会再变一次。
ex.note: undoubtedly 无疑，肯定地

ex.en: The label gives the name and the date of the object, but not its usage.
ex.cn: 标签上写着这件东西的名称和年代，却没有写明它的用途。
ex.note: the usage of … …的用法；instructions for usage 使用说明

ex.en: Starting a small business is a risky venture.
ex.cn: 开一家小生意是件有风险的事。
ex.note: a joint venture 合资企业；venture capital 风险投资

ex.en: Few people venture into the market at such an early age.
ex.cn: 很少有人在这么小的年纪就敢闯市场。
ex.note: venture to do 敢于做；venture into 闯入

ex.en: Every visitor is asked to leave large bags in the cloakroom.
ex.cn: 每位来访者都被要求把大包留在寄存处。
ex.note: a regular visitor 常客；the visitors' book 来访者留言簿

ex.en: She washed the shelves with a damp cloth.
ex.cn: 她用一块湿布擦了擦架子。
ex.note: wash one's hands 洗手；wash down 冲洗

ex.en: She put the clothes out for a wash in the sun.
ex.cn: 她把衣服拿到太阳底下洗。
ex.note: for a wash 供洗；give it a wash 洗一洗

ex.en: He heard a weird noise from the empty hall.
ex.cn: 他从空荡荡的大厅里听到一阵奇怪的声音。
ex.note: weird behaviour 奇怪的行为；a weird feeling 奇异的感觉

ex.en: He wanted to know whose handwriting appeared on the label.
ex.cn: 他想知道标签上的字迹出自谁的手。
ex.note: whose 是 who 的所有格

ex.en: We wondered why the museum was so empty that morning.
ex.cn: 我们纳闷那天早上博物馆为什么这么空。
ex.note: wonder about 对…感到好奇；I wonder … 我想知道…

ex.en: The old bridge is one of the wonders of the region.
ex.cn: 那座老桥是这一带的奇迹之一。
ex.note: a wonder of … …的奇迹；wonders of the world 世界奇观

ex.en: The doctor took an X-ray and found nothing broken.
ex.cn: 医生拍了一张X光片，什么也没发现。
ex.note: an X-ray of … …的X光片；X-ray vision 透视能力
